description: Adds products to a wishlist made earlier, given its edit link or the token at the end of it. A product already on the list keeps its place and takes the new note. A list holds at most 50 products; unknown or unavailable products, and products that no longer fit, are reported and not added. Returns the list's items with their best current prices. The token stops working once the list has been saved to a Plendio account.

edit_token.description: The wishlist's edit link as returned when it was created, or just the token at the end of it.

items.description: The products to add: 1 to 50. A product already on the list keeps its place and takes the new note.

note.description: Optional short note shown with the product, e.g. a size or colour. Up to 140 characters; markup and links are removed.

product_id.description: Plendio product id (the id field of a search result).

slug.description: Alternative to product_id: the product's url, or the slug-and-id at its end (acme-book-15-42). The number after the last dash is the id.

market.description: Market for the urls in the answer: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market the list was made for.

name: add_to_wishlist

added.description: Product ids put on the list.

already_on_list.description: Product ids that were already on the list (their note was updated).

available.description: False for a product that has left the catalogue or has no offer now.

note.description: Text written by whoever made the list.

price_from.description: Cheapest current price in the catalogue, in major units of currency; absent when no shop lists one.

url.description: The product's page on Plendio, listing all its offers.

not_on_list.description: Product ids that were not on the list.

not_stored.description: Products that could not be added, with the reason.

product.description: What was given for the product (its id or slug).

removed.description: Product ids taken off the list.

share_url.description: The list's page on Plendio, read-only.

title.description: The list's name, written by whoever made it.

total_from.description: Sum of price_from over the available items; absent when their currencies differ or none has a price.

title: Add products to a wishlist
